items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: No, I don't know nothing of him either.

ctx.x: Brunus. Up there in the Irish channel? Yeah. Well they, they had a band I believe of Brunus.

Did you ever play with any of those fellas? Richard Brunus, Henry Brunus? No, never did. I wondered uh Happy Schilling, do you remember Happy Schilling, a trombone player? No, I don't remember him either. He was uptown too. And uh Tom Brown, do you remember Tom Brown?

No, I don't know nothing of him either. You don't remember? No, this man lives next door here, Mr. Lane, he had a brother they buried him a few years ago. He used to be a good trombone player too. Oh yeah, which uh Julian Lane?
